#  Module 13 Challenge
> Module 13 Classification Challenge for ASU AI Bootcamp

In this challenge, I role-played consulting for an Internet Service Provider (ISP) where I was tasked with improving the email filtering system for its customers. I was provided with a dataset that contained information about emails, with two possible classifications: spam and not spam. The ISP wanted me to take this dataset and develop a supervised machine learning (ML) model that will accurately detect spam emails so it can filter them out of its customers' inboxes.
To achieve the objectives, I created two classification models to fit the provided data, and evaluated which model was more accurate at detecting spam. The models I created were a logistic regression model and a random forest model..

## Installing / Getting started

Open the spam_detector.ipynb Jupyter notebook using a Jupyter server. Explore the data.

```jupyter lab
spam_detector.ipynb
```

Run each part of the code in the notebook to explore the data.
